crew.overview: The extraordinary tale of Harriet Tubman's escape from slavery and transformation into one of America's greatest heroes. Her courage, ingenuity and tenacity freed hundreds of slaves and changed the course of history.
crew.title: Harriet

details.biography:
Gayette Williams is a hairstylist and a member of IATSE Local 798. Her career includes contributions to critically acclaimed titles such as Harriet (2019), Shirley (2024), and Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 (2026).

In December 2024, the Make-Up Artists & Hair Stylists Guild—affiliated with IATSE Local 706—announced nominations for their 12th annual Guild Awards, with Gayette Williams being co-nominated for Best Period and/or Character Hair Styling for her work on Shirley (Netflix), alongside Lisa Thomas.
details.name: Gayette Williams
